methods.share: The Wilson score interval of the verified warnings in all the warnings, at the level of the file.
methods.overYears: The percentile bootstrap interval over the years: 10000 draws of the years with replacement, with a fixed seed for each measure.
methods.gate: The hull of the intervals of a measure and its value. A new value out of the gate interval of the committed file stops the workflow. A measure that a file does not have is 0 with the gate interval 0 to 0.
methods.noRead: The gate reads a share only when each year has 10 or more verified and 10 or more unverified warnings. Otherwise the gate gives no read for the share: not a pass and not a break.
methods.unverified: Cow links no storm report to some phenomena. The file keeps their counts with the reason and the evidence, and it has no share for them.
methods.cow: One request for each month, with one day of margin before and after the month. A warning counts in the month of its start. The id of a warning counts one time.
methods.ncei: The rows of each file of details, by EVENT_TYPE. The deaths and injuries of a type are the sums of the direct and indirect counts.
